text:
Maya R: quick handoff from me — I'm primary for next 8h, Aj you're secondary. I'll be on PTO from 00:30 UTC so flag anything urgent in this thread before then.

Aj T: ack. I can take pages after 00:30 UTC. reminder: if you see latency > 800ms p95 for >5m escalate to pager.

Maya R: noted. coverage gap: no one in APAC overnight, Zane can you cover critical pages in first 2h? otherwise we'll rely on PagerDuty rotation.

Zane K: I can cover the first 2h. if it goes long ping me directly (DM) and i'll extend.

Samira L: quick FYI — customer-impacting incidents (errors, data-loss, auth failures) bubble to SEV1; anything just latency/degraded throughput is SEV2 unless customers are timing-out.

Maya R: runbook pointers: latency spikes => https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/latency-spike ; auth failures => https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/auth-failure ; deployment rollbacks => https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/rollback-plan . keep these handy.

incident-bot: [ALERT] 1840001120 - API latency p95 1.2s for inference-api-prod (region: us-west). Triggered auto-scale policy.

Aj T: seeing the bot alert. Maya are you still on the line?

Maya R: i'm still here for 6m. first quick checklist: check autoscaler, check recent deploys, check queue backlog.

Zane K: pulling metrics — queue depth on inference-queue up x3, pods are at desired count but CPU near 95% on each. likely need vertical headroom or scale faster.

Samira L: customer impact? any timeouts reported?

Aj T: no 504s yet, but some chattiness from big customers — their SDKs time out at 1.5s. we should avoid a customer-visible spike.

Maya R: mitigation plan (quick): 1) temporarily increase HPA minReplicas to +3 for inference-api 2) enable emergency burst pool in Dedicated (if applicable) 3) route a fraction of traffic to fallback model variant (lower-cost/quantized) -> reduces latency.

Aj T: commands:```kubectl -n prod patch hpa inference-api --patch '{"spec":{"minReplicas":8}}'``` and ```kubectl rollout restart deployment inference-api -n prod``` doing patch now.

Zane K: opsbot note: if rollout restarts exceed 2m per pod, revert. keep KV-cache warms in mind.

opsbot: executed autoscaler patch at 1840001160 by Aj T. added 3 min replicas.

Maya R: toggled traffic split to 10% fallback model via console -> https://console.redwood.com/traffic . keep an eye on error_rate.

Samira L: good. add to incident log: why autoscaler didn't react earlier — metric window was 5m, consider short-term reduce to 1m during high-traffic windows. runbook note updated: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/latency-spike#tuning-hpa .

Aj T: p95 down to 480ms after the patch and traffic split. queue depth trending down. I'll watch for the next 15m and then roll back the HPA min bump if stable.

Maya R: handoff items for Aj: 1) if p95 > 700ms for 10m, escalate to SEV2 and notify Eng SRE via phone. 2) if error_rate > 1% for 5m, trigger rollback to previous model-version. 3) if autoscaler fails to add capacity, open a priority ticket to infra and use emergency hotspot pool.

Aj T: got it. i'll document actions in the incident channel and tidy the runbook links.

Zane K: i'll stay reachable for 2h then hand to next APAC buddy. leaving a quick commands crib:
- check logs: `kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-api --since=10m | grep ERROR`
- check queue: `redis-cli -h redis-prod LLEN inference-queue`
- rollback: `redwoodctl deploy rollback inference-api --to-revision=rev-42`

Samira L: small note on customer comms: if customers ask, say 'experiencing transient latency; mitigation in place. no data loss. root cause under investigation.' don't promise ETA.

Maya R: ok i'm handing off officially now — Aj primary, Zane coverage for 2h, Samira on comms. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Aj T: thanks Maya. i'll ping this thread for updates and close when stable.

incident-bot: [INFO] 1840001380 - p95 470ms (steady) — monitor until 1840001700.

Aj T: noted. last_message: keeping thread pinned and I'll archive once metrics are stable for 30m.
